Tango Icons

The Tango Desktop Project exists to help create a consistent graphical user interface experience for free and Open Source software.

Used in the "Weather Info (C++/QML)" example

The sources can be found in tqtc-qt5/qtlocation/examples/positioning/weatherinfo/icons/weather-few-clouds.png, tqtc-qt5/qtlocation/examples/positioning/weatherinfo/icons/weather-overcast.png, tqtc-qt5/qtlocation/examples/positioning/weatherinfo/icons/weather-showers.png, tqtc-qt5/qtlocation/examples/positioning/weatherinfo/icons/weather-storm.png, and tqtc-qt5/qtlocation/examples/positioning/weatherinfo/icons/weather-snow.png.
